## Sweep: fixes and exceptions

Searches covered pnpm/npm stores, module caches, explicit chmod/read-only modes, tar extraction modes and snapshot fixtures. Search output is saved locally as `sweep-01.log` and `readonly-files-01.txt`; the table below lists concrete code sites rather than asserting arbitrary dynamically computed mode coverage.

- Fixed: all temporary roots in the four manager conformance fixtures now register restoration before callers populate/seal them, covering capture stores, real-manager execution roots, private stores/mirrors/caches, materialized outputs and work trees. Previously cleanup was registered after a fallible producer and only for the store.
- Restoration uses a preorder walk, ORs owner write into existing permissions, and skips symlinks; it preserves executable bits and does not chmod an external target.
- Module caches: `internal/godriver/session.go:395` creates private cache directories; `session.go:445` closes the build environment (`GOPROXY=off`, `GOSUMDB=off`), builds use vendored modules rather than downloading readonly cache trees. `main_test.go:228` closes sessions. CI Go module caches live under `RUNNER_TEMP`, separate from the Go test `TMPDIR`; the new hook-root restore does not claim to rewrite those caches.
- Existing protected-tree owners: `internal/buildrepo/local.go:92` registers release before sealing; `local.go:858` restores during release. `internal/closureexec/closureexec_test.go:26,472,509,581` restores/removes owned captures. `internal/swiftpmbuild/fixture_test.go:58`, `internal/swiftpmsource/swiftpmsource_test.go:628`, `internal/swiftpmsource/swift_integration_test.go:64` register recursive restore before building child fixtures. Rust manager tests close managers (for example `internal/rustsource/build_test.go:33`), whose owned cleanup restores permissions (`manager.go:837`).
- Archive fixture headers are inert bytes until extracted by the tested adapter. The npm/Yarn/pnpm extraction roots are now covered by early cleanup. `internal/artifactpolicy/test_helpers_test.go:34` builds header fixtures; it does not extract them into a readonly filesystem tree.

files.workflow-echo-plant.yml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    # gate/** carries the throwaway snapshots scripts/remote-gate.sh pushes
    # for the task-board landing gate; the branch is deleted after the run.
    branches: [main, 'gate/**']
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate_ref:
        description: >-
          Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate
          suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision
          publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected.
          Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.
        required: false
        default: ""
      candidate_root:
        description: >-
          Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner.
          Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
        required: false
        default: ""
      candidate_manifest_sha256:
        description: >-
          Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run
          rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
        required: false
        default: ""

# Serialize repeated runs of the same workflow/ref without cancelling pushes.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # The one immutable committed conformance-root pin, referenced by every
  # default and comparison job. This is curator-spec commit
  # curator-spec v1.0.0-rc.14 peeled tag commit 43bf0a2506d5c354a73bbc3ea4623d4653db10c7; its conformance/v1
  # manifest digest is sha256:6f832d813efc768ea154a7d5076b512ab4be6aa9409d92e11469d21ea9bc69f5.
  # The pin is not a release qualification or a conformance claim. Candidate
  # suites enter through the non-default `candidate-conformance` job only.
  # The root serves the whole module; suite-plan.sh defers nothing against it.
  SPEC_PIN: 43bf0a2506d5c354a73bbc3ea4623d4653db10c7
  # actions/setup-go only began forcing GOTOOLCHAIN=local in v6.0.0; this
  # workflow pins @v5, so without these two lines a job may download a
  # toolchain or read a per-user go env file. The identity step below reads
  # both back rather than trusting this block.
  GOTOOLCHAIN: "local"
  # Quoted deliberately: bare `off` is a YAML 1.1 boolean and would reach the
  # runner as "false", which is a real per-user go env file path, not "off".
  GOENV: "off"
  # The one pnpm release the real-pnpm integration tests admit. This is a
  # COPY of internal/pnpmsource.SupportedPNPMVersion, kept next to the lanes
  # that install it so the installed release is visible in the workflow; the
  # copy cannot drift silently because `.github/ci/pnpm-pin-guard.sh` fails
  # any lane where the two disagree. Every lane that runs the Go test suite
  # installs exactly this release with npm into a lane-local prefix (see the
  # per-lane steps), so the TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases execute everywhere
  # instead of skipping for "pinned pnpm executable unavailable" -- and so a
  # broken pnpm shim that happens to be first on a self-hosted runner's PATH
  # can no longer fail the lane, as the macbook-iv fallback shim did on run
  # 35072267145 (`node <shim> --version` died with a SyntaxError on the
  # shim's `set -euo pipefail` line, failing `read pnpm version` in
  # newConcretePNPMRunner). The lane-local bin directory is prepended via
  # GITHUB_PATH precisely to outrank any such ambient shim.
  #
  # npm, not corepack, is the installer: the tests resolve the pnpm
  # executable and stage its package root, which a corepack dispatcher shim
  # does not provide (rehearsal: 3x FAIL MODULE_NOT_FOUND with corepack, 3x
  # PASS with npm-installed pnpm).
  PNPM_PIN: "10.33.0"

jobs:
  # Every admitted family gets its own real toolchain identity and driver
  # qualification. Linux keeps the protocol's existing build refusal; native
  # offline vendored builds replay twice with cold caches on macOS/Windows.
  go-family-qualification:
    name: Go ${{ matrix.go }} driver (${{ matrix.os }})
    # Linux entries run on the repository's self-hosted Linux runners when the
    # LINUX_SELF_HOSTED repository variable is true, for pushes, dispatches and
    # same-repository pull requests. A pull request from a fork always stays on
    # the hosted image, whatever the variable says. See
    # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md.
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        go: ['1.25.5', '1.26.0', '1.27.1']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Initialize private Go state
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh

      - name: Checkout authoritative protocol suite
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: relux-works/curator-spec
          ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
          path: protocol-spec
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' || runner.os != 'Linux' }}
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}
      - name: Verify family toolchain identity
        shell: bash
        env:
          QUALIFIED_GO_VERSION: ${{ matrix.go }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          actual="$(go version)"
          echo "$actual"
          [[ "$actual" == "go version go$QUALIFIED_GO_VERSION "* ]]
          [[ "$(go env GOTOOLCHAIN)" == local ]]
          [[ -z "$(go env GOENV)" || "$(go env GOENV)" == off ]]
      - name: Driver qualification and reproducibility
        shell: bash
        env:
          CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/protocol-spec/conformance/v1
          CURATOR_REAL_GO_TEST: '1'
          CURATOR_REAL_GO_BUILD_TEST: ${{ runner.os != 'Linux' && '1' || '0' }}
          GOFLAGS: '-work'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == Linux ]]; then
            go test -count=1 -timeout=10m -v ./internal/godriver -run 'Test(QualifiedGoFamilies|UnknownGoFamiliesRemainRefused|RealTrustedGoProbe|ProbeRejectsAnUncoveredPlatformBeforeTheWorker|ToolchainIdentityVectors)$'
          else
            go test -count=1 -timeout=10m -v ./internal/godriver
          fi
      - name: Driver vet
        run: go vet ./internal/godriver
      - name: Build manager
        run: go build ./cmd/curator
      - name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
        if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: echo 'bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh'


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # The default lane, against the committed conformance pin, on all three runners.
  #
  # `test-gate.sh` plans the run from that root alone. The committed pin
  # publishes every artefact `.github/ci/root-artifacts.tsv` declares, so the
  # deferred set is empty here and every package runs with
  # CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT exported; a pin that stopped publishing one would
  # defer its package and name the missing artefact in the report rather than
  # dropping it. `internal/godriver` -- which implements
  # rc5-native-control-inventory-v1, defined for macOS and Windows only -- is
  # excluded on linux with its fail-closed rejection asserted there. Nothing is
  # dropped without appearing in the uploaded evidence.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  test:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.os }})
    # Linux entries run on the repository's self-hosted Linux runners when the
    # LINUX_SELF_HOSTED repository variable is true, for pushes, dispatches and
    # same-repository pull requests. A pull request from a fork always stays on
    # the hosted image, whatever the variable says. See
    # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md.
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Initialize private Go state
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh

      - name: Checkout authoritative protocol suite
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: relux-works/curator-spec
          ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
          path: protocol-spec

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' || runner.os != 'Linux' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      # The hosted images ship their own Node, but the pnpm the
      # TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases admit is installed here, never taken from
      # the image: setup-node guarantees an npm toolchain, and the
      # lane-local prefix below is prepended to PATH so it outranks any
      # ambient pnpm shim (macbook-iv run 35072267145: a broken fallback
      # shim first on PATH failed `read pnpm version` and turned the
      # rose-air lane red).
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Verify pnpm pin matches Go constant
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/pnpm-pin-guard.sh

      - name: Install pinned pnpm via npm
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Lane-local prefix: npm stages a REAL pnpm package root here, which
          # the TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases need (they resolve the executable
          # and stage dir(dir(entrypoint))). A corepack dispatcher shim
          # provides no such root (rehearsal: MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
          npm install -g --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" "pnpm@${{ env.PNPM_PIN }}"
          # npm lays out the global bin dir per platform ($prefix/bin on unix,
          # the prefix root itself on Windows); prepend both so the pinned
          # pnpm is first on PATH on every runner and outranks any ambient
          # shim (macbook-iv run 35072267145).
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix/bin" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify rust pin matches Go constant
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/rust-pin-guard.sh

      # rustup is the installer on every runner: the hosted images ship it,
      # and the self-hosted runner gets it once per
      # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md. The install step reads the channel
      # from rust-toolchain.toml (verified above against
      # internal/rustsource.SupportedRustToolchainVersion), installs exactly
      # that toolchain, and prepends the rustup shim directory to PATH, so
      # `rustc -vV` in the rustsource production cases resolves the pinned
      # release instead of failing the lane (rose-air run 35121791685).
      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain via rustup
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/install-rust-toolchain.sh

      - name: Verify Go toolchain identity
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/toolchain-identity.sh

      - name: Verify versioned Go install compatibility
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/release-source-gate.sh

      - name: gofmt check
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          unformatted="$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"
          if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then
            echo "gofmt: files need formatting:"
            echo "$unformatted"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: go vet
        run: go vet ./...

      # Proves the ledger's platform claims against the real per-GOOS builds:
      # a case required on windows must actually compile into the windows
      # build, and a case compiled into a build the ledger never mentions is a
      # coverage gap rather than a silent pass.
      - name: Ledger consistency
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/ledger-consistency.sh .temp/ci-evidence/ledger

      # Runs the planned package set and enforces .github/ci/platform-cases.tsv:
      # the Windows runner must execute the DACL, reparse-point and `.cmd`
      # launcher cases; the unix runners must execute the ownership, no-follow,
      # read-only-source, resource-policy and executable cases; and every skip
      # anywhere in the run is classified and recorded by name.
      #
      # The per-package deadline is a hosted-runner budget, not a behavioural
      # bar. Windows still gets 120m: on run 32648313266 its cmd/curator and
      # internal/install/atomicity packages took 1099s and 1027s against 454s
      # and 125s on macOS; after the transactional publication sweep,
      # internal/install reached 3516s of the 60m budget on run 35424565415.
      # Ubuntu and macOS get 60m. On green run 35709048693, internal/install
      # took 926.106s (Test/ubuntu), 558.623s (Test/macOS), 1114.886s
      # (Race/ubuntu), and 537.885s (Race/macOS). Their fractions of 60m are
      # 25.7%, 15.5%, 31.0%, and 14.9%. Run 35713206841 hit 1800.165s in
      # Test/ubuntu and run 35994653101 hit 1800.100s in Race/ubuntu during
      # runner contention. Every lane retains Go's fatal per-package timeout.
      - name: go test + platform-case gate
        shell: bash
        env:
          CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/protocol-spec/conformance/v1
          GO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '120m' || '60m' }}
        run: bash .github/ci/test-gate.sh .temp/ci-evidence/test

      - name: Upload gate evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-evidence-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: .temp/ci-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
        if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # The same default lane on the organisation's self-hosted macOS ARM64
  # runner (rose-air). Hosted macos-latest stays authoritative for the
  # platform claim; this lane adds an Apple-silicon execution host the
  # operator controls, so a hosted-image regression and a real-machine
  # regression are distinguishable. It runs the identical gate scripts and
  # uploads its own evidence under a distinct name.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gated on the repository variable ROSE_AIR_RUNNER=true: the runner is
  # registered for the organisation's board repository only until an
  # administrator registers it for this repository, and an unmatched
  # self-hosted label would leave the job queued forever.
  # Pinned to the rose-air runner by its `rose-air` label: the generic
  # self-hosted/macOS/ARM64 labels alone let any organisation Apple-silicon
  # runner take the job (gate-selftest.sh pins the label).
  test-self-hosted:
    name: Test (rose-air)
    # Runs on main pushes only: every landing gets self-hosted evidence, while
    # pull requests and gate snapshots stay on the hosted matrix, because the
    # single self-hosted slot is shared with other repositories and would
    # serialise every candidate behind unrelated 90-minute runs.
    if: ${{ vars.ROSE_AIR_RUNNER == 'true' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64, rose-air]
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Checkout authoritative protocol suite
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: relux-works/curator-spec
          ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
          path: protocol-spec

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      # The hosted macOS image ships Node; the self-hosted runner does not.
      # internal/npmsource's real-npm cases skip with "npm unavailable"
      # otherwise, a reason the skip classes do not tolerate on darwin.
      # The same toolchain provisions the npm-installed pnpm below.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      # This lane is where the incident happened (macbook-iv run 35072267145:
      # a broken fallback pnpm shim first on PATH failed `read pnpm
      # version`). The lane-local prefix bin directory is prepended to PATH
      # precisely to outrank any such ambient shim.
      - name: Verify pnpm pin matches Go constant
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/pnpm-pin-guard.sh

      - name: Install pinned pnpm via npm
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Lane-local prefix: npm stages a REAL pnpm package root here, which
          # the TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases need (they resolve the executable
          # and stage dir(dir(entrypoint))). A corepack dispatcher shim
          # provides no such root (rehearsal: MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
          npm install -g --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" "pnpm@${{ env.PNPM_PIN }}"
          # npm lays out the global bin dir per platform ($prefix/bin on unix,
          # the prefix root itself on Windows); prepend both so the pinned
          # pnpm is first on PATH on every runner and outranks any ambient
          # shim (macbook-iv run 35072267145).
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix/bin" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify rust pin matches Go constant
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/rust-pin-guard.sh

      # rustup is the installer on every runner: the hosted images ship it,
      # and the self-hosted runner gets it once per
      # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md. The install step reads the channel
      # from rust-toolchain.toml (verified above against
      # internal/rustsource.SupportedRustToolchainVersion), installs exactly
      # that toolchain, and prepends the rustup shim directory to PATH, so
      # `rustc -vV` in the rustsource production cases resolves the pinned
      # release instead of failing the lane (rose-air run 35121791685).
      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain via rustup
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/install-rust-toolchain.sh

      - name: Verify Go toolchain identity
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/toolchain-identity.sh

      - name: gofmt check
        shell: bash
        run: |
          unformatted="$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"
          if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then
            echo "gofmt: files need formatting:"
            echo "$unformatted"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: go vet
        run: go vet ./...

      - name: Ledger consistency
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/ledger-consistency.sh .temp/ci-evidence/ledger

      - name: go test + platform-case gate
        shell: bash
        env:
          CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/protocol-spec/conformance/v1
          GO_TEST_TIMEOUT: 60m
        run: bash .github/ci/test-gate.sh .temp/ci-evidence/test

      - name: Upload gate evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-evidence-rose-air
          path: .temp/ci-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Race.
  #
  # macos-latest is an inventory platform, so `-race` there covers the whole
  # package set including internal/godriver, satisfying the acceptance
  # criteria's race gate on a supported runner. ubuntu-latest satisfies the
  # "supported race job on at least Linux" clause and covers transaction,
  # buildcache, install, install/atomicity and interop; godriver is excluded
  # there by the protocol's own qualification, with the exclusion asserted
  # rather than assumed.
  #
  # windows-latest is deliberately absent: the Go race detector needs a C
  # toolchain there and this repository has no measurement that the hosted
  # image satisfies it. Recorded, not silently dropped.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  race:
    name: Race (${{ matrix.os }})
    # Snapshot publication refuses ACL-bearing retained ancestry. Qualified
    # self-hosted Linux runners meet this boundary; the hosted Linux image
    # does not. Match Test routing for pushes, dispatches and same-repository
    # pull requests when LINUX_SELF_HOSTED is true; forks stay hosted and
    # their snapshot controls are expected to refuse. See the runner setup doc.
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Initialize private Go state
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh

      - name: Checkout authoritative protocol suite
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: relux-works/curator-spec
          ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
          path: protocol-spec

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' || runner.os != 'Linux' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      # Same provisioning as the Test lane: the TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases
      # run under -race too, so the pinned pnpm is installed here and
      # prepended to PATH ahead of any ambient shim (macbook-iv run
      # 35072267145).
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Verify pnpm pin matches Go constant
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/pnpm-pin-guard.sh

      - name: Install pinned pnpm via npm
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Lane-local prefix: npm stages a REAL pnpm package root here, which
          # the TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases need (they resolve the executable
          # and stage dir(dir(entrypoint))). A corepack dispatcher shim
          # provides no such root (rehearsal: MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
          npm install -g --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" "pnpm@${{ env.PNPM_PIN }}"
          # npm lays out the global bin dir per platform ($prefix/bin on unix,
          # the prefix root itself on Windows); prepend both so the pinned
          # pnpm is first on PATH on every runner and outranks any ambient
          # shim (macbook-iv run 35072267145).
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix/bin" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify rust pin matches Go constant
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/rust-pin-guard.sh

      # rustup is the installer on every runner: the hosted images ship it,
      # and the self-hosted runner gets it once per
      # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md. The install step reads the channel
      # from rust-toolchain.toml (verified above against
      # internal/rustsource.SupportedRustToolchainVersion), installs exactly
      # that toolchain, and prepends the rustup shim directory to PATH, so
      # `rustc -vV` in the rustsource production cases resolves the pinned
      # release instead of failing the lane (rose-air run 35121791685).
      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain via rustup
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/install-rust-toolchain.sh

      - name: Verify Go toolchain identity
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/toolchain-identity.sh

      # internal/install took 1114.886s on ubuntu-latest and 537.885s on
      # macos-latest in green Race jobs on gate run 35709048693. Both fit under
      # half of the 60m per-package timeout. Run 35994653101 later reached the
      # old 30m deadline during ubuntu runner contention; the timeout still
      # expires and fails a package that genuinely hangs.
      - name: go test -race + platform-case gate
        shell: bash
        env:
          CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/protocol-spec/conformance/v1
          GO_TEST_FLAGS: -race
          GO_TEST_TIMEOUT: 60m
        run: bash .github/ci/test-gate.sh .temp/ci-evidence/race

      - name: Upload race evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: race-evidence-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: .temp/ci-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
        if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh

  lint:
    name: Lint
    # Linux entries run on the repository's self-hosted Linux runners when the
    # LINUX_SELF_HOSTED repository variable is true, for pushes, dispatches and
    # same-repository pull requests. A pull request from a fork always stays on
    # the hosted image, whatever the variable says. See
    # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md.
    runs-on: ${{ (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Initialize private Go state
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' || runner.os != 'Linux' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Verify Go toolchain identity
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/toolchain-identity.sh

      # `version: latest` is a mutable supply-chain input: a new golangci-lint
      # release can turn this job red with no repository change. Pinned to the
      # version `latest` resolved to when this gate was written.
      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v7
        with:
          version: v2.12.2
          skip-cache: ${{ runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux' }}

      # The routing tests evaluate the workflow expression subset with Node.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Verify Linux CI isolation
        shell: bash
        run: go test -count=1 ./tools/ciworkflow/

      # Security findings may be suppressed narrowly and by name; they may not
      # be suppressed wholesale. A suppression that names no rule silences
      # every rule, including ones written after the comment.
      - name: No broad suppression
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/no-broad-suppression.sh

      # The rc channel guard: every homebrew_casks/scoops skip_upload and
      # release.prerelease must parse as exactly "auto", or a release
      # candidate silently replaces the stable tap/bucket release (2026-08
      # incident). The Go test parses .goreleaser.yml with gopkg.in/yaml.v3
      # (a text walk cannot tell a block scalar body from a real key, rev3
      # R1); gate-selftest.sh pins this exact step structurally, and the
      # test also asserts its own wiring.
      - name: Verify GoReleaser rc channel values
        shell: bash
        run: go test -count=1 ./tools/goreleaserconfig/
      - name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
        if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh


  # The gates are only worth their exit codes if they reject what they claim
  # to reject. This runs on all three runners because the gate scripts must
  # behave identically under Git Bash on Windows.
  gate-selftest:
    name: Gate self-test (${{ matrix.os }})
    # Linux entries run on the repository's self-hosted Linux runners when the
    # LINUX_SELF_HOSTED repository variable is true, for pushes, dispatches and
    # same-repository pull requests. A pull request from a fork always stays on
    # the hosted image, whatever the variable says. See
    # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md.
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Initialize private Go state
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh

      - name: Self-test the CI gates
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/gate-selftest.sh
      - name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
        if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh

  interop:
    name: Interop conformance gate
    # Linux entries run on the repository's self-hosted Linux runners when the
    # LINUX_SELF_HOSTED repository variable is true, for pushes, dispatches and
    # same-repository pull requests. A pull request from a fork always stays on
    # the hosted image, whatever the variable says. See
    # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md.
    runs-on: ${{ (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Initialize private Go state
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh

      - name: Checkout authoritative protocol suite
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: relux-works/curator-spec
          ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
          path: protocol-spec

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' || runner.os != 'Linux' }}
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Verify Go toolchain identity
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/toolchain-identity.sh

      - name: Shared protocol suite
        env:
          CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/protocol-spec/conformance/v1
        run: go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/interop/ -v
      - name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
        if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh

  naming-gate:
    name: Naming gate
    # Linux entries run on the repository's self-hosted Linux runners when the
    # LINUX_SELF_HOSTED repository variable is true, for pushes, dispatches and
    # same-repository pull requests. A pull request from a fork always stays on
    # the hosted image, whatever the variable says. See
    # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md.
    runs-on: ${{ (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Initialize private Go state
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh

      - name: Employer name gate
        # Rules, the binary-patch exemption and the assembled-from-parts
        # patterns live in the script; gate-selftest.sh drives its rows.
        run: bash .github/ci/naming-gate.sh
      - name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
        if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh

  candidate-conformance:
    name: Candidate suite (${{ matrix.os }})
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      (inputs.candidate_ref != '' || inputs.candidate_root != '')
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      # A revision and a pre-materialised root are independent identities.
      # Reject the ambiguous combination before checking out either candidate
      # revision or recording any candidate evidence.
      - name: Reject ambiguous candidate inputs
        shell: bash
        env:
          CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
          CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT: ${{ inputs.candidate_root }}
        run: bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh verify-inputs "$CANDIDATE_REF" "$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT"

      - name: Reject a non-immutable candidate revision
        if: inputs.candidate_ref != ''
        shell: bash
        env:
          CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
        run: bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh verify-ref "$CANDIDATE_REF"

      - name: Check out the candidate suite
        if: inputs.candidate_ref != ''
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: relux-works/curator-spec
          ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
          path: candidate-spec

      # The committed conformance pin is checked out here only so the candidate
      # can be proved to differ from it. This job never runs against it and
      # never modifies it.
      - name: Checkout the committed conformance pin for comparison
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: relux-works/curator-spec
          ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
          path: protocol-spec

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      # Same provisioning as the Test lane: this lane runs the full suite
      # through test-gate.sh, so the TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases execute here
      # too, against the pinned pnpm prepended to PATH ahead of any ambient
      # shim (macbook-iv run 35072267145).
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Verify pnpm pin matches Go constant
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/pnpm-pin-guard.sh

      - name: Install pinned pnpm via npm
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Lane-local prefix: npm stages a REAL pnpm package root here, which
          # the TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases need (they resolve the executable
          # and stage dir(dir(entrypoint))). A corepack dispatcher shim
          # provides no such root (rehearsal: MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
          npm install -g --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" "pnpm@${{ env.PNPM_PIN }}"
          # npm lays out the global bin dir per platform ($prefix/bin on unix,
          # the prefix root itself on Windows); prepend both so the pinned
          # pnpm is first on PATH on every runner and outranks any ambient
          # shim (macbook-iv run 35072267145).
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix/bin" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify rust pin matches Go constant
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/rust-pin-guard.sh

      # rustup is the installer on every runner: the hosted images ship it,
      # and the self-hosted runner gets it once per
      # docs/self-hosted-runner-setup.md. The install step reads the channel
      # from rust-toolchain.toml (verified above against
      # internal/rustsource.SupportedRustToolchainVersion), installs exactly
      # that toolchain, and prepends the rustup shim directory to PATH, so
      # `rustc -vV` in the rustsource production cases resolves the pinned
      # release instead of failing the lane (rose-air run 35121791685).
      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain via rustup
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/install-rust-toolchain.sh

      - name: Verify Go toolchain identity
        shell: bash
        run: bash .github/ci/toolchain-identity.sh

      - name: Resolve and record the candidate suite identity
        id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
          CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT: ${{ inputs.candidate_root }}
          CANDIDATE_EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.candidate_manifest_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -u
          if [ -n "$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT" ]; then
            root="$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT"
          else
            root="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/candidate-spec/conformance/v1"
          fi
          echo "root=$root" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          pin_manifest="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/protocol-spec/conformance/v1/manifest.json"
          if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256="$(shasum -a 256 <"$pin_manifest" | awk '{print $1}')"
          else
            PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256="$(sha256sum <"$pin_manifest" | awk '{print $1}')"
          fi
          export PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256
          bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh record "$root" .temp/ci-evidence/candidate

      # The full candidate suite on every platform. The platform-case ledger is
      # enforced exactly as in the default lane, and CI_REQUIRE_FULL_ROOT=1
      # additionally forbids the package deferral the default lane would permit
      # against a root that published less than the committed pin does.
      #
      # The committed pin serves the whole module, so the default and candidate
      # lanes have the same package plan. Ubuntu/macOS use 60m for the measured
      # internal/install load; Windows retains 120m for its slower syscall and
      # process-spawn path. The per-package deadline is fixed and fatal.
      - name: Candidate suite + platform-case gate
        shell: bash
        env:
          CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.root }}
          CI_REQUIRE_FULL_ROOT: "1"
          GO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '120m' || '60m' }}
        run: bash .github/ci/test-gate.sh .temp/ci-evidence/test

      - name: Upload candidate evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: candidate-evidence-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: .temp/ci-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn

concurrency:
    cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
env:
    GOENV: "off"
    GOTOOLCHAIN: local
    PNPM_PIN: 10.33.0
    SPEC_PIN: 43bf0a2506d5c354a73bbc3ea4623d4653db10c7
jobs:
    candidate-conformance:
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (inputs.candidate_ref != '' || inputs.candidate_root != '')
        name: Candidate suite (${{ matrix.os }})
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                submodules: true
            - env:
                CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
                CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT: ${{ inputs.candidate_root }}
              name: Reject ambiguous candidate inputs
              run: bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh verify-inputs "$CANDIDATE_REF" "$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT"
              shell: bash
            - env:
                CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
              if: inputs.candidate_ref != ''
              name: Reject a non-immutable candidate revision
              run: bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh verify-ref "$CANDIDATE_REF"
              shell: bash
            - if: inputs.candidate_ref != ''
              name: Check out the candidate suite
              uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                path: candidate-spec
                ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
                repository: relux-works/curator-spec
            - name: Checkout the committed conformance pin for comparison
              uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                path: protocol-spec
                ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
                repository: relux-works/curator-spec
            - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
              with:
                go-version-file: go.mod
            - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
              with:
                node-version: "22"
            - name: Verify pnpm pin matches Go constant
              run: bash .github/ci/pnpm-pin-guard.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Install pinned pnpm via npm
              run: |
                set -euo pipefail
                # Lane-local prefix: npm stages a REAL pnpm package root here, which
                # the TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases need (they resolve the executable
                # and stage dir(dir(entrypoint))). A corepack dispatcher shim
                # provides no such root (rehearsal: MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
                npm install -g --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" "pnpm@${{ env.PNPM_PIN }}"
                # npm lays out the global bin dir per platform ($prefix/bin on unix,
                # the prefix root itself on Windows); prepend both so the pinned
                # pnpm is first on PATH on every runner and outranks any ambient
                # shim (macbook-iv run 35072267145).
                echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix/bin" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
                echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
              shell: bash
            - name: Verify rust pin matches Go constant
              run: bash .github/ci/rust-pin-guard.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain via rustup
              run: bash .github/ci/install-rust-toolchain.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Verify Go toolchain identity
              run: bash .github/ci/toolchain-identity.sh
              shell: bash
            - env:
                CANDIDATE_EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.candidate_manifest_sha256 }}
                CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
                CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT: ${{ inputs.candidate_root }}
              id: candidate
              name: Resolve and record the candidate suite identity
              run: |
                set -u
                if [ -n "$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT" ]; then
                  root="$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT"
                else
                  root="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/candidate-spec/conformance/v1"
                fi
                echo "root=$root" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

                pin_manifest="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/protocol-spec/conformance/v1/manifest.json"
                if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                  PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256="$(shasum -a 256 <"$pin_manifest" | awk '{print $1}')"
                else
                  PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256="$(sha256sum <"$pin_manifest" | awk '{print $1}')"
                fi
                export PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256
                bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh record "$root" .temp/ci-evidence/candidate
              shell: bash
            - env:
                CI_REQUIRE_FULL_ROOT: "1"
                CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.root }}
                GO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '120m' || '60m' }}
              name: Candidate suite + platform-case gate
              run: bash .github/ci/test-gate.sh .temp/ci-evidence/test
              shell: bash
            - if: always()
              name: Upload candidate evidence
              uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
              with:
                if-no-files-found: warn
                name: candidate-evidence-${{ matrix.os }}
                path: .temp/ci-evidence/
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                os:
                    - ubuntu-latest
                    - macos-latest
                    - windows-latest
    gate-selftest:
        name: Gate self-test (${{ matrix.os }})
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || matrix.os }}

            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            - if: runner.os == 'Linux'
              name: Initialize private Go state
              run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Self-test the CI gates
              run: bash .github/ci/gate-selftest.sh
              shell: bash
            - continue-on-error: false
              if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
              name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
              run: bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh
              shell: bash
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                os:
                    - ubuntu-latest
                    - macos-latest
                    - windows-latest

              with:

                ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
                repository: relux-works/curator-spec
            - uses: actions/setup-go@v5

                cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' || runner.os != 'Linux' }}
                go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}
            - env:
                QUALIFIED_GO_VERSION: ${{ matrix.go }}
              name: Verify family toolchain identity
              run: |
                set -euo pipefail
                actual="$(go version)"
                echo "$actual"
                [[ "$actual" == "go version go$QUALIFIED_GO_VERSION "* ]]
                [[ "$(go env GOTOOLCHAIN)" == local ]]

              if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'

              shell: bash
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false

                    - ubuntu-latest
                    - macos-latest

        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:

                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'

                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.

                default: ""

    cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
env:
    GOENV: "off"
    GOTOOLCHAIN: local
    PNPM_PIN: 10.33.0
    SPEC_PIN: 43bf0a2506d5c354a73bbc3ea4623d4653db10c7
jobs:
    candidate-conformance:
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (inputs.candidate_ref != '' || inputs.candidate_root != '')
        name: Candidate suite (${{ matrix.os }})
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                submodules: true
            - env:
                CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
                CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT: ${{ inputs.candidate_root }}
              name: Reject ambiguous candidate inputs
              run: bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh verify-inputs "$CANDIDATE_REF" "$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT"
              shell: bash
            - env:
                CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
              if: inputs.candidate_ref != ''
              name: Reject a non-immutable candidate revision
              run: bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh verify-ref "$CANDIDATE_REF"
              shell: bash
            - if: inputs.candidate_ref != ''
              name: Check out the candidate suite
              uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                path: candidate-spec
                ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
                repository: relux-works/curator-spec
            - name: Checkout the committed conformance pin for comparison
              uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                path: protocol-spec
                ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
                repository: relux-works/curator-spec
            - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
              with:
                go-version-file: go.mod
            - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
              with:
                node-version: "22"
            - name: Verify pnpm pin matches Go constant
              run: bash .github/ci/pnpm-pin-guard.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Install pinned pnpm via npm
              run: |
                set -euo pipefail
                # Lane-local prefix: npm stages a REAL pnpm package root here, which
                # the TestRealPinnedPNPM* cases need (they resolve the executable
                # and stage dir(dir(entrypoint))). A corepack dispatcher shim
                # provides no such root (rehearsal: MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
                npm install -g --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" "pnpm@${{ env.PNPM_PIN }}"
                # npm lays out the global bin dir per platform ($prefix/bin on unix,
                # the prefix root itself on Windows); prepend both so the pinned
                # pnpm is first on PATH on every runner and outranks any ambient
                # shim (macbook-iv run 35072267145).
                echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix/bin" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
                echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
              shell: bash
            - name: Verify rust pin matches Go constant
              run: bash .github/ci/rust-pin-guard.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain via rustup
              run: bash .github/ci/install-rust-toolchain.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Verify Go toolchain identity
              run: bash .github/ci/toolchain-identity.sh
              shell: bash
            - env:
                CANDIDATE_EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.candidate_manifest_sha256 }}
                CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
                CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT: ${{ inputs.candidate_root }}
              id: candidate
              name: Resolve and record the candidate suite identity
              run: |
                set -u
                if [ -n "$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT" ]; then
                  root="$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT"
                else
                  root="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/candidate-spec/conformance/v1"
                fi
                echo "root=$root" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

                pin_manifest="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/protocol-spec/conformance/v1/manifest.json"
                if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                  PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256="$(shasum -a 256 <"$pin_manifest" | awk '{print $1}')"
                else
                  PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256="$(sha256sum <"$pin_manifest" | awk '{print $1}')"
                fi
                export PIN_MANIFEST_SHA256
                bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh record "$root" .temp/ci-evidence/candidate
              shell: bash
            - env:
                CI_REQUIRE_FULL_ROOT: "1"
                CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.root }}
                GO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '120m' || '60m' }}
              name: Candidate suite + platform-case gate
              run: bash .github/ci/test-gate.sh .temp/ci-evidence/test
              shell: bash
            - if: always()
              name: Upload candidate evidence
              uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
              with:
                if-no-files-found: warn
                name: candidate-evidence-${{ matrix.os }}
                path: .temp/ci-evidence/
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                os:
                    - ubuntu-latest
                    - macos-latest
                    - windows-latest

        name: Gate self-test (${{ matrix.os }})
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || matrix.os }}
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            - if: runner.os == 'Linux'
              name: Initialize private Go state
              run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Self-test the CI gates
              run: bash .github/ci/gate-selftest.sh
              shell: bash
            - continue-on-error: true
              if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
              name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
              run: bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh
              shell: sh
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                os:
                    - ubuntu-latest
                    - macos-latest
                    - windows-latest

        name: Go ${{ matrix.go }} driver (${{ matrix.os }})
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && (vars.LINUX_SELF_HOSTED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)) && fromJSON('["self-hosted","relux-linux","curator"]') || matrix.os }}
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
            - if: runner.os == 'Linux'
              name: Initialize private Go state
              run: bash .github/ci/isolate-go-state.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Checkout authoritative protocol suite
              uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                path: protocol-spec
                ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
                repository: relux-works/curator-spec
            - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
              with:
                cache: ${{ runner.environment != 'self-hosted' || runner.os != 'Linux' }}
                go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}
            - env:
                QUALIFIED_GO_VERSION: ${{ matrix.go }}
              name: Verify family toolchain identity
              run: |
                set -euo pipefail
                actual="$(go version)"
                echo "$actual"
                [[ "$actual" == "go version go$QUALIFIED_GO_VERSION "* ]]
                [[ "$(go env GOTOOLCHAIN)" == local ]]
                [[ -z "$(go env GOENV)" || "$(go env GOENV)" == off ]]
              shell: bash
            - env:
                CURATOR_CONFORMANCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/protocol-spec/conformance/v1

                GOFLAGS: -work

              run: |
                set -euo pipefail

                fi

            - name: Build manager

            - continue-on-error: true
              if: always() && runner.environment == 'self-hosted' && runner.os == 'Linux'
              name: Restore runner temporary tree permissions
              run: bash scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh
              shell: bash
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                go:
                    - 1.25.5
                    - 1.26.0
                    - 1.27.1
                os:
                    - ubuntu-latest
                    - macos-latest
                    - windows-latest

name: CI
"on":
    pull_request: null
    push:
        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**
    workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
                required: false
permissions:
    contents: read

                default: ""

            - main

            - main

                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.

        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:

                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.

        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.

    pull_request: null

        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
                required: false

"on":
    pull_request: null

        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
                required: false

    SPEC_PIN: 43bf0a2506d5c354a73bbc3ea4623d4653db10c7

    candidate-conformance:
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (inputs.candidate_ref != '' || inputs.candidate_root != '')
        name: Candidate suite (${{ matrix.os }})
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                submodules: true
            - env:
                CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
                CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT: ${{ inputs.candidate_root }}
              name: Reject ambiguous candidate inputs
              run: bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh verify-inputs "$CANDIDATE_REF" "$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT"
              shell: bash
            - env:
                CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
              if: inputs.candidate_ref != ''
              name: Reject a non-immutable candidate revision
              run: bash .github/ci/candidate-suite.sh verify-ref "$CANDIDATE_REF"
              shell: bash
            - if: inputs.candidate_ref != ''
              name: Check out the candidate suite
              uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                path: candidate-spec
                ref: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
                repository: relux-works/curator-spec
            - name: Checkout the committed conformance pin for comparison
              uses: actions/checkout@v4
              with:
                path: protocol-spec
                ref: ${{ env.SPEC_PIN }}
                repository: relux-works/curator-spec
            - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
              with:
                go-version-file: go.mod
            - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
              with:
                node-version: "22"

              run: bash .github/ci/pnpm-pin-guard.sh
              shell: bash

                # pnpm is first on PATH on every runner and outranks any ambient

                echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix/bin" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
                echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm-prefix" >>"$GITHUB_PATH"
              shell: bash

              run: bash .github/ci/rust-pin-guard.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain via rustup
              run: bash .github/ci/install-rust-toolchain.sh
              shell: bash
            - name: Verify Go toolchain identity

              shell: bash

                CANDIDATE_EXPECTED_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.candidate_manifest_sha256 }}
                CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ inputs.candidate_ref }}
                CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT: ${{ inputs.candidate_root }}
              id: candidate
              name: Resolve and record the candidate suite identity
              run: |
                set -u
                if [ -n "$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT" ]; then
                  root="$CANDIDATE_ROOT_INPUT"
                else
                  root="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/candidate-spec/conformance/v1"

                echo "root=$root" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

                default: ""

                default: ""

"on":
    pull_request: null
    push:
        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**
    workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
                required: false

    contents: read

        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""

                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
                required: false

"on":
    pull_request: null
    push:
        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**
    workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
                required: false
permissions:
    contents: read

            - main

            - main

                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'

                default: ""

                default: ""

    pull_request: null

        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.

                default: ""

            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""

                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'

            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.

            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""

                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'

            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.

            - main
            - gate/**

        inputs:

                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'

                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.

"on":
    pull_request: null
    push:
        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**
    workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
                required: false
permissions:
    contents: read

"on":
    pull_request: null
    push:
        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**
    workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
                required: false

    contents: read

                default: ""

                default: ""

name: CI
"on":
    pull_request: null
    push:
        branches:
            - main
            - gate/**
    workflow_dispatch:
        inputs:
            candidate_manifest_sha256:
                default: ""
                description: Expected sha256 of <root>/manifest.json. When set, a mismatch aborts the run rather than silently re-baselining onto a different candidate.
                required: false
            candidate_ref:
                default: ""
                description: 'Full 40-character relux-works/curator-spec revision holding the candidate suite. The lane is schema-agnostic: it qualifies whatever suite the revision publishes. Branches, tags, short hashes and placeholders are rejected. Leave empty to use candidate_root instead.'
                required: false
            candidate_root:
                default: ""
                description: Absolute path to a conformance/v1 root already materialised on the runner. Use instead of candidate_ref when the candidate has no published revision.
                required: false
permissions:
    contents: read
